note: King County, TX has no published zoning districts. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web found only parcel, tax and farmland data (paid or Pro-only) and no zoning layer. Guthrie, the county seat, is an unincorporated town with no city zoning found; the Guthrie ROKMAPS portal belongs to Guthrie, Oklahoma. Texas counties generally lack zoning authority.
